project_type: SaaS Educational Management System - Express backend + Next.js frontend
build_system: npm with tsc for backend, next build for frontend
test_framework: Jest with ts-jest preset, tests in /tests directory organized by module
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build:backend to compile TypeScript. 2. Run npm test for backend tests. 3. Run prisma validate to check schema. 4. Docker build to validate deployment config.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js 22 with npm and pnpm available. No PostgreSQL running locally.
contribution_requirements: Branch: feat/remaining-modules. All code in TypeScript. Backend uses Express with Prisma ORM. Frontend uses Next.js 14 with App Router.
key_patterns: Backend: services layer with Prisma queries, controllers delegate to services, routes use authMiddleware, errorHandler at top level. Frontend: pages use mock data arrays with DataTable component, useApi hook exists for real API calls but is not used in pages yet. API client in src/frontend/lib/api.ts handles auth tokens via localStorage.
directory_structure: saas-educacional/ - root with package.json, prisma/, src/backend/ (server, routes, controllers, services, middleware, utils), src/frontend/ (Next.js app with (auth) and (dashboard) route groups, components, hooks, lib), tests/ (organized by module: auth, cadastros, matriculas, notas, diario, estagios, financeiro, requerimentos, atas)
